This closes synthetic-pretrain plus recent-only adaptation as below frontier.
next_step_recommendation: Run 562a: reuse the 561a synthetic checkpoint but fine-tune on a much larger real pre-validation window set before recent adaptation/evaluation. The hypothesis is that synthetic prior exposure can help only after broad real-data fine-tuning recovers the empirical IV transition law.
